title: Stalkwise exactness of the concrete Godement model
statement: For a scheme $X$, a module sheaf $F$, a cosimplicial module sheaf $A$, and an augmentation $a:F[0]\to K(A)$ satisfying ModuleCupGodementModel, the morphism $a$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Only the actual terms, unit-insertion cofaces and degree-zero germ map are assumed; no multiplication is required.

source.place: Godement resolution; Lemma 20.30.1 (0FKS); monad multiplication and tensor compatibility: Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, section 1.1.4, pp. 15--16.

proof.text: Apply moduleCup_godement_stalk_contraction at every point. Mathlib HomotopyEquiv.quasiIso_hom (equivalently homotopyEquivalences_le_quasiIso) makes every stalk augmentation a quasi-isomorphism.

Prove stalk additivity directly on germs. The exactness criterion module_stalk_exact supplies preservation of exact short complexes, hence stalk preservation of homology. In each degree use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality to express the stalk of the sheaf homology map as the conjugate of the stalk-complex homology map, which is an isomorphism. The stalk morphism is bijective; isIso_of_bijective_stalkLinearMap reflects this to an isomorphism of sheaf homology objects. This is QuasiIso.

theorem moduleCup_godement_model_quasiIso (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
    (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (h : ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a) : QuasiIso a
